pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with softened edge gradients due to image resolution; larger, more angular geometries on the shoulder transitioning to smaller, more rounded sub-units on the mid-flank and hindquarter.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological grid; junction nodes are primarily trifurcated; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, upright mane showing low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background at the neck-shoulder junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two dark avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck.
